bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 500L
	w = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
	Z = matrix(rnorm(n * 4L), n, 4L)
	X = cbind(treatment = as.numeric(w), Z)
	colnames(X) = c("treatment", paste0("x", 1:4))
	eta = drop(X %*% c(-0.5, 0.4, -0.3, 0.2, 0.1))
	t_ev = rexp(n, rate = 0.2 * exp(eta))
	t_cens = runif(n, 0, 15)
	time = ceiling(pmin(t_ev, t_cens) * 2) / 2   # half-unit grid: many tied times
	dead = as.numeric(t_ev <= t_cens)
	row_weights = rexp(n)                        # one Bayesian-bootstrap draw
	list(time = as.numeric(time), dead = dead, X = X, w = as.numeric(row_weights))
}

bench_run = function(d) {
	# Weighted Efron Cox MLE by damped Newton on coxdev's C++ deviance, gradient and
	# matrix-free information (the operator is applied to X, giving X'IX in O(n p^2)).
	X = d$X
	w = d$w
	cox = coxdev::CoxDeviance$new(event = d$time, status = d$dead, sample_weight = w,
		tie_breaking = "efron")
	beta = rep(0, ncol(X))
	eta = drop(X %*% beta)
	res = cox$compute(eta, w)
	for (it in 1:50) {
		score = -drop(crossprod(X, res$gradient)) / 2
		info = cox$information(eta, w)
		H = crossprod(X, info$multiply(X))
		step = drop(solve(H, score))
		s = 1
		repeat {
			beta_new = beta + s * step
			eta_new = drop(X %*% beta_new)
			res_new = cox$compute(eta_new, w)
			if (res_new$deviance <= res$deviance + 1e-12 * abs(res$deviance) || s < 1e-4) break
			s = s / 2
		}
		beta = beta_new
		eta = eta_new
		res = res_new
		if (max(abs(s * step)) < 1e-10) break
	}
	as.numeric(beta)
}
